title: MURCIÉLAGO Anime Reveals New Visual, Trailer, Main Cast
content: The previously announced MURCIÉLAGO anime revealed a new visual and trailer, along with three additional cast members on Wednesday. It is slated to premiere in January 2027 with HIDIVE exclusively simulcasting in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.
author: Anime Corner

title: 3 Spooky Anime You Should Watch on Hulu This October
content: With October nearing its end, it is the perfect time to embrace spooky elements, and Hulu , an emerging anime streaming platform, offers a variety of options to amplify the spookiness. With an abundance of series and streaming platforms to choose from, selecting what to watch has become increasingly difficult.
author: ComicBook

title: Writer Skyfarm, Artist Tentashi's Wildcard Alchemist Manga Ends
content: Manga UP! Global publishes the manga in English digitally and describes the story: When a toxic guild dumps their "worthless, junk-making" alchemist, they make the biggest mistake of their lives. Iluto, an alchemist, is abruptly kicked out of Dragnate—the very guild that recruited him.
author: ANN

title: Hikaru Nakamura's Black Night Parade Manga Ends, Teases Major Announcement on December 18
content: Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga in English digitally and in print. The company describes the story: Hino Miharu will be spending this Christmas just like the last: alone and working a dead-end job.
author: ANN

title: Naruto Finally Gets a New Hokage, and It’s the One Fans Always Wanted (But Not Like This)
content: The Hokage has always been an important part of Naruto , and celebrating a new one might just be the biggest occasion of all. Now, the Naruto franchise’s sequel, Boruto , is heading toward another change in the Hokage’s position, and while it is set to feature a candidate who is highly suitable for the role, it is…

title: Shiten Akiyama's Horizon Manga Resumes
content: Kodama Tales licensed the manga, and it will release the first volume in January 2027. The company describes the story: Mieko Fujiwara is a burnt-out office worker nearing the end of her twenties.
author: ANN

title: 40 Years Later, Starship Troopers Should Return To Anime
content: A recently reported reboot of the Starship Troopers franchise brings the 1997 cult classic to mind for a lot of people, but it wasn’t the first attempt at bringing Robert Heinlein’s novel to life. Would you like to know more?

title: Live-Action Twisted Sisters Series Reveals Cast
content: NHK revealed the cast members for the live-action series for Kazumi Yamashita 's Twisted Sisters manga on Tuesday. The cast (including the previously announced Miori Takimoto ) includes (pictured above from left to right): • Yumia Fujisaki as Tiara Ioroi • Hikari Ishida as Junko Ioroi • Miori Takimoto as Rikako Ioroi…
author: ANN

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Showrunner Addresses Anime’s Future After Season 2 Finale
content: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 has brought the anime series to yet another conclusive end, and the showrunner behind it all opened up to ComicBook about the potential future of the franchise after that finale.
author: ComicBook

title: Live-Action Look Back Film Screens in N. American Theaters on December 30
content: GKIDS announced on Tuesday that it will screen the live-action film of Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot in select theaters in North America on December 30 followed by a wider release in theaters on January 15.
author: ANN
